levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن بشر بن مسعود

notes: «رده إلى» marks a link that the text does not name between Abd al-Rahman and Abu Said, read as an unnamed gap as «يرفعه إلى» is (rule 8)
«واللفظ لأبي كامل» is a wording remark and is left out; «- وهو ابن زيد -» is a gloss and is left out
«قال محمد وقوله لا عليكم» is a commentary by Muhammad, not a link (rule 6)
